method: Floodplain, bridge and coastal values (finished-floor freeboard above the base flood elevation and above stormwater ponding or overflow, the allowable rise in flood elevations, the compensatory storage ratio, bridge low-chord freeboard and bridge design storm) read by hand from every atlas manual with its own rules. Candidate sentences were found by text search and each was read and judged: is it this rule, stated as a requirement (ok) or as a recommendation, a definition or a typical value (typical)? Many states regulate floodplains through ordinances that are not in the atlas, so these values come mostly from city, county and DOT manuals. Statistics count one value per state (the median of that state's manuals).
